title: VPC Provisioning Visuals + Upgrade Modal for Private Deployments
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Create a set of onboarding visuals for Private/VPC provisioning: a concise networking flow diagram, step-by-step install tiles for customer-controlled environments, and an upgrade management modal for private control planes. Assets will be used in the quickstart doc, Console release notes, and a short in-app tutorial.
design_notes: Primary emphasis on separating control plane vs data plane to reduce networking misconceptions
Use simplified AWS-like icons but generic provider-agnostic labels
Create two complexity levels: 'Quick' (3 step tiles) and 'Advanced' (full CIDR details + routing)
Upgrade modal should show semantic versioning, preflight checks, and a rollback CTA
Color palette follows Console tokens: primary-600 for actions, neutral-200 for backgrounds, danger-500 for warnings
steps: Draft initial flow diagram and two install tile variations
Produce compact upgrade modal mock and a full-screen upgrade workflow
Export copy-safe PNGs and SVGs for docs and Console integration
Run PM/Eng/Security reviews and iterate on network language
Prepare developer handoff with redline measurements and export tokens
